_comment: 'THIS and the next action card you play this turn get go again' — two grants, one immediate and one queued on the play-time queue (the next action card need not attack). The gate is approximated: the text says the LAST action card played this turn was Lightning, and only 'a Lightning card was played this turn' is recorded, so a Lightning play followed by a non-Lightning one still passes. More permissive than printed; stated rather than hidden.
